title: Parting Hooks (离别钩) - Stats, Combo & How to Get
description: Parting Hooks (离别钩) in Phantom Blade Zero - weapon class, slot, stats, combo contribution and how to obtain it, with unconfirmed numbers left marked as unconfirmed.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Parting Hooks (离别钩) is a dual-wielded blade pair in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. Guard stance counters melee, so it is a defensive pick that punishes commitment rather than a damage pick.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Parting Hooks (离别钩) occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as Dual-wield. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Parting Hooks (离别钩) has no published damage, scaling or speed figure, because the game does not print a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons. Nothing has been measured for this one either, so those three numbers are absent rather than estimated - the slot and the property are what the choice actually turns on.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content:
The reason to carry it is its property rather than a damage number: Guard stance counters melee.

Switching to it mid-combo refills stamina, so its practical job is to extend a chain past the point where the blade you were using runs dry. See the combat system for how the swap window works.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Pangzhen, Dockside Warehouse.

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.
